thread:
noah: Kickoff for 'Autopilot' social burst. Need: X thread (bench-first), LinkedIn long post, 30s demo clip for X, hero static + gif, and a post-event recap post. Schedule target: benchmark thread on May 10, reminder on May 13, webinar May 15.

leigh: noted. who owns the demo clip?

maria: I can take hero static + gif. will need final copy by Thursday noon.

gabi: I'll own the demo clip edit. Send me the raw footage and the highlight timestamps. Prefer markers for start/end.

noah: Gabi: aim for 0:12-0:42 highlight window with overlay at 0:08 showing the p99 delta. keep captions on.

sam: For the benchmark thread: 3 tweets max. Proposed structure: 1) headline + register CTA, 2) p50/p95/p99 numbers + microchart, 3) short note on quantization + link to raw CSV.

maria: I'll make a tweet-sized microchart PNG and a stylized LinkedIn banner. Keep fonts large.

leigh: Routing: HubSpot form -> map fields: company_size, vertical, region, benchmark_interest, demo_interest. Rule: company_size>1000 OR lead_score>75 -> SDR immediate. rest -> nurture.

sam: Add cookie for campaign=autopilot_spring for attribution. Also UTM utm_campaign=autopilot_spring for links.

noah: Can we get an engagement follow-up plan? i.e., anyone who replies or quotes the thread -> SDR alert + auto DM with shortlink to on-demand video.
\e: (typo)

gabi: yes, can wire engagement webhooks. need the exact Slack channel for SDR alerts.

maria: putting assets into /marketing/assets/autopilot_spring. filenames: hero_card_v1.png, hero_banner_li_v1.png, demo_clip_v1.mp4, microchart_tweet.png.

sam: campaign-bot schedule please: bench thread May 10 09:00 PT, reminder May 13 11:00 PT, webinar day live thread May 15 08:45 PT.

campaign-bot: Scheduled posts: May 10 09:00 PT (benchmark thread), May 13 11:00 PT (reminder), May 15 08:45 PT (live thread). Copy-freeze set for May 8 17:00 PT.

noah: Copy drafts: X teaser: "We cut gen-latency in half. See the numbers + demo May 15. Register -> {shortlink}" Benchmark tweet 1: headline + quick stat + register. Tweet 2: p50/p95/p99 + microchart. Tweet 3: note on quantization + raw csv link. LI post: longer narrative with a customer quote.

maria: uploaded v1 copy and hero comps to the folder. @leigh can you confirm HubSpot field mappings?

leigh: Confirmed. also added sdq_region tag. SDR rota updated to include APAC morning on-call for 48h after the webinar.

noah: Great. Last thing: add a short post-event recap (key numbers + link to recording) and a small A/B test on the X teaser CTA (Register vs Watch). We'll track CTRs.

gabi: got it. will deliver demo_clip_v2 if we need a shorter variant for story format.

sam: I'll set tracking events for CTR, signups, and demo-views.

noah: Thanks team. eyes on copy-freeze May 8. :rocket:
